title: Guan Yu: the man and the legend
summary: Thirteen stops from the peach garden to Jade Spring Hill. Each step says whether the story is history, embellished, or invented; with Guan Yu more than with anyone, the legend outgrew the man.
summary_zh: 从桃园到玉泉山十三站，每站都标明是正史、演义加工还是虚构。三国人物中，传说超过本人最多的就是关羽。

steps.text: [Fiction] The oath in the peach garden. The Records says only that the three were close as brothers.
steps.text_zh: 【虚构】桃园结义。史书只说三人“恩若兄弟”。

steps.text: [Fiction] Hua Xiong killed before the wine cools. Sun Jian's men killed him; Guan Yu was not there.
steps.text_zh: 【虚构】温酒斩华雄。华雄实为孙坚所斩，关羽并不在场。

steps.text: [Embellished] The three conditions on Tushan. In history he was simply captured.
steps.text_zh: 【演义加工】土山约三事。史实上他只是兵败被擒。

steps.text: [History] Yan Liang at Baima: the one great duel the Records tells as the novel does.
steps.text_zh: 【正史】白马斩颜良，这是史书与小说记载一致的一场阵前斩将。

steps.text: [Fiction] Five passes, six generals: switch on the five-passes layer to see how far out of the way the route runs. None of it happened.
steps.text_zh: 【虚构】过五关斩六将。打开“过五关路线”图层，可以看到这条路绕了多远。史书并无此事。

steps.text: [Embellished] Cai Yang at Gucheng. Liu Bei killed him, in Runan.
steps.text_zh: 【演义加工】古城斩蔡阳。蔡阳实为刘备在汝南所杀。

steps.text: [Fiction] Huarong: he lets Cao Cao go. Invented; Liu Bei simply arrived too late.
steps.text_zh: 【虚构】华容道义释曹操。虚构，史实是刘备追之不及。

steps.text: [Embellished] The single-sword meeting. Lu Su called it and Lu Su did the scolding.
steps.text_zh: 【演义加工】单刀赴会。发起会面、当面责备的其实是鲁肃。

steps.text: [Embellished] Seven armies drowned. The autumn rains did it; he used them.
steps.text_zh: 【演义加工】水淹七军。是秋雨使汉水泛滥，关羽乘势进攻。

steps.text: [Embellished] Scraping the bone while playing chess: real, though the surgeon was not Hua Tuo.
steps.text_zh: 【演义加工】刮骨疗毒、谈笑弈棋确有其事，只是医生并非华佗。

steps.text: [History] Lü Meng's men in white take Jiangling behind him.
steps.text_zh: 【正史】吕蒙白衣渡江，袭取江陵。

steps.text: [History] Captured at Linju and beheaded.
[Fiction] The ghost at Jade Spring Hill: the beginning of a cult that made him a god.
steps.text_zh: 【虚构】玉泉山显圣：此后千年，关羽被尊为关帝。

title: The Red Cliffs, history and invention
summary: Eleven steps through the most famous campaign in Chinese fiction. Watch the colours under the markers: one battle that is history, surrounded by stratagems that are not.
summary_zh: 十一步走完中国小说中最著名的一场战役。留意标记下的颜色：一场真实的大战，四周环绕着一连串虚构的计谋。

steps.text: [Embellished] Changban: Zhao Yun saves the infant heir.
steps.text_zh: 【演义加工】长坂坡，赵云救出幼主。

steps.text: [Embellished] Zhang Fei holds the bridge with a glare.
steps.text_zh: 【演义加工】张飞据水断桥，瞋目横矛。

steps.text: [Embellished] Zhuge Liang argues down Wu's advisers.
[History] Sun Quan cuts the table: no more talk of surrender.
steps.text_zh: 【正史】孙权拔刀斫案，决意抗曹。

steps.text: [Fiction] Jiang Gan and the forged letter.
[Fiction] A hundred thousand arrows borrowed in the fog.
[Fiction] Huang Gai takes the beating.
[Fiction] Pang Tong talks Cao Cao into chaining his ships.
[Fiction] The east wind called down from the seven-star altar.
[History] Fire at the Red Cliffs. The battle is real; so is Huang Gai's fire.
steps.text_zh: 【正史】火烧赤壁。大战与黄盖火攻都是真的。

steps.text: [Fiction] Huarong, and Cao Cao's escape.

title: Zhuge Liang
summary: Fourteen steps from the thatched cottage to Wuzhang Plains. The novel made him a wizard; the history shows a statesman whose own words survive.
summary_zh: 从草庐到五丈原十四步。小说把他写成了近乎神算的奇人，史书里的他则是一位留下了亲笔文字的政治家。

steps.text: [History] Three visits to the cottage, as he himself wrote.
steps.text_zh: 【正史】三顾茅庐，他在《出师表》中亲笔写过。

steps.text: [History] The Longzhong plan.
[Embellished] Bowang: a real ambush, five years before he arrived.
steps.text_zh: 【演义加工】博望坡：确有此战，但比他出山早了五年。

steps.text: [Embellished] The embassy to Wu.
[Fiction] The east wind, the novel's wizardry.
steps.text_zh: 【虚构】借东风，小说中的神机妙算。

steps.text: [History] Liu Bei's charge at Baidi.
[Embellished] Meng Huo seven times: a later, doubtful number.
steps.text_zh: 【演义加工】七擒孟获，次数出自后来的记载，颇可怀疑。

steps.text: [History] The memorial on leaving for the north.
[History] Ma Su loses Jieting.
[Fiction] The empty fort: a story Pei Songzhi already refuted.
steps.text_zh: 【虚构】空城计，裴松之当年就已驳斥。

steps.text: [History] Ma Su executed, in tears.
[Embellished] Wooden oxen and gliding horses.
[Fiction] Rain saves Sima Yi at Shangfang Valley.
steps.text_zh: 【虚构】上方谷，大雨救了司马懿。

steps.text: [History] The star falls at Wuzhang Plains.

title: Liu Bei, from straw sandals to emperor
title_zh: 刘备：从织席贩履到称帝
summary: Fifteen steps through a life spent losing and starting again: Zhuo, Xuzhou, Xu, Jingzhou, Chengdu, Baidi.
summary_zh: 十五步走完屡败屡起的一生：涿郡、徐州、许都、荆州、成都、白帝城。

steps.text: [Fiction] The peach garden at Zhuo.
[Embellished] The inspector whipped. It was Liu Bei's own temper, not Zhang Fei's.
steps.text_zh: 【演义加工】鞭打督邮，动手的其实是刘备本人。

steps.text: [Embellished] Xuzhou offered to him.
[Embellished] Talking of heroes with Cao Cao.
steps.text_zh: 【演义加工】与曹操煮酒论英雄。

steps.text: [History] Routed, he flees to Yuan Shao.
[Embellished] The leap over the Tan Stream.
[History] Three visits to Zhuge Liang.
[History] Fleeing south with the people.
[Embellished] Married to Sun Quan's sister.
[History] Into Shu, at Liu Zhang's invitation.
[History] Chengdu is his.
[History] King of Hanzhong.
[History] Emperor of Han, at Chengdu.
[History] Burned out at Yiling.
[History] Death at Baidi.

title: Long divided, the realm unites
summary: Ninety-six years in fifteen steps, from the Yellow Turbans to the surrender of Wu. Watch the borders change under the markers: one Han, a dozen warlords, three states, one Jin.
summary_zh: 十五步走完九十六年，从黄巾起义到吴国投降。留意疆域的变化：一个汉朝，十几路诸侯，三个国家，最后归于一个晋朝。

steps.text: [History] 184: the Yellow Turbans rise across a united Han.
steps.text_zh: 【正史】184年：黄巾起义，汉朝尚是一统。

steps.text: [History] 190: Dong Zhuo burns Luoyang; the governors take their provinces.
steps.text_zh: 【正史】190年：董卓焚洛阳，州郡长官各据一方。

steps.text: [History] 196: Cao Cao takes the emperor to Xu.
[History] 200: Guandu decides the north.
steps.text_zh: 【正史】200年：官渡之战决定北方归属。

steps.text: [History] 208: the Red Cliffs stop Cao Cao in the south.
steps.text_zh: 【正史】208年：赤壁之战阻止曹操南下。

steps.text: [History] 214: Liu Bei takes Yizhou; three powers.
steps.text_zh: 【正史】214年：刘备取益州，三分之势已成。

steps.text: [History] 220: Cao Pi ends the Han; three emperors follow.
steps.text_zh: 【正史】220年：曹丕代汉，三国相继称帝。

steps.text: [History] 222: Yiling fixes the border between Shu and Wu.
steps.text_zh: 【正史】222年：夷陵之战后蜀吴边界从此定型。

steps.text: [History] 234: Zhuge Liang dies; the north is not retaken.
steps.text_zh: 【正史】234年：诸葛亮病逝，北伐终未成功。

steps.text: [History] 249: the Sima take Wei.
[History] 263: Deng Ai crosses Yinping.
[History] 263: Shu surrenders.
[History] 265: Jin replaces Wei.
[History] 280: Wang Jun's fleet comes down the Yangzi.
[History] 280: Wu surrenders; the realm is one.
